scaredsfactions.faction.setting.enable_f: Enables a glowing effect for friendlies, with a color of your choosing!

scaredsfactions.faction.setting.info_vis: When set to true, this faction is discoverable with /faction list and /faction info <name>.
scaredsfactions.faction.setting.owner_ra: This setting determines which rank is the highest, Stadhouder or Generalissimus.

This setting is dependent on the global settings, thus can be overridden, thus this value is useless if overridden. Contact your server admin if you suspect the value isn't changing before submitting an issue!
It's default value is whatever the server owner has set in the config. It can be changed, or not!
scaredsfactions.faction.setting.sbw_frie: When set to true, pvp with guns from Superbwarfare will be enabled.
This setting does not appear when the mod Superbwarfare is not installed.

This setting is dependent on the global settings, thus can be overridden, thus this value is useless if overridden. Contact your server admin if you suspect the value isn't changing before submitting an issue!
scaredsfactions.faction.setting.tacz_fri: Enable Timeless and Classics: Zero Friendly Fire
When set to true, pvp with guns from Timeless and Classics: Zero will be enabled.
This setting does not appear when the mod Timeless and Classics: Zero is not installed.

This setting is dependent on the global settings, thus can be overridden, thus this value is useless if overridden. Contact your server admin if you suspect the value isn't changing before submitting an issue!
scaredsfactions.faction.setting.vanilla_: When set to true, vanilla pvp (axes, swords, etc) within this faction will be enabled.

This setting is dependent on the global settings, thus can be overridden, thus this value is useless if overridden. Contact your server admin if you suspect the value isn't changing before submitting an issue!
